title: 딱지가 떨어진 날
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop City Pop track at 115 BPM in E Major. The arrangement features a clean, funk-influenced electric guitar playing syncopated 16th-note rhythms and a melodic electric bass with a bright, round tone. A digital piano provides rhythmic chord stabs. The drums consist of a crisp snare and a tight kick drum. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, conversational tenor range with light compression and subtle plate reverb. The production uses a polished, high-fidelity aesthetic characteristic of modern Korean pop with a retro 1980s influence.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar funk riff, melodic electric bass, digital piano stabs]

[Verse 1]
[male tenor vocals]
수습 끝났다고 팀장이 커피 사줬어
이제 정식이야 축하해
동기들이 부러워하는데 배가 좀 이상해
어제까지는 물어볼 수 있었잖아
수습이니까 봐주는 거잖아
오늘부터는 변명이 없어

[Chorus]
딱지가 떨어졌어
방패가 사라졌어
수습이란 말이 이렇게 편한 줄
왜 몰랐을까

[Outro]
[guitar and bass continue, fading out]
